definition: [ חָרִיט ] noun masculine 1Kgs 5:23 bag, purse (compare Arabic bag or purse made of skin or other material) — only plural absolute שְׁנֵי חֲרִטִים 2Kgs 5:23 , containing each a talent of silver; הָֽחֲרִיטִים Isa 3:22 in list of ladies' finery.
